## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] The change is focused and does not include private product code or data.
- [ ] Behavior changes have focused tests or a reason tests are not applicable.
- [ ] Public APIs, limitations, and examples are documented where needed.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic and contain no customer or personal data.
- [ ] Third-party code/assets are identified and license notices are preserved.
- [ ] Generated license files were refreshed when dependencies changed.
- [ ] I reviewed compatibility and preservation risks for unsupported OOXML.
